text: The one breaking change this week is #13759, which removes CLEAN27 obsolete code across the W1 and regional apps, including 140 deleted AL files, so extensions that still use those objects need updating. Several behaviour changes also landed. #13361 lays groundwork for Payables Agent v2.0, and v1 KPIs now count finalized purchase invoices. #13582 filters subscription packages strictly by price group. #13883 switches existing Shopify shops that still had the uninitialized Quote value to process returns as credit memos. #13720 splits the MS-STD configuration package into nine functional-area packages. #13928 adds certificate authentication for master data synchronization. #13554 adds Fabric API procedures for importing configuration packages and resetting or removing tables, and #13824 normalizes Fabric namespaces to lowercase. Fixes in warehouse and manufacturing cover #13552, #13699, #13724 and #13778. Posting and VAT fixes include #13467, #13414, #13482, #13805 and #13628. Smaller fixes hit item attributes (#13855, #13898), Report 713 (#13607, #13801), the Expense Agent (#13760, #13499, #13730) and XRechnung export (#13822), while #13672 exposes VAT setup in the Expense Agent wizard. #9587 adds concurrent posting for G/L entries. Extensibility gains are #13060, #9522 and #9523. #13952 and #13953 add an email attachment key for faster deletion, and #13893 and #13764 improve index management.

issues: #13883 is overstated: the upgrade step only sets Process Returns As to Credit Memo for existing shops still holding the uninitialized Quote (0) value; shops already set to Credit Memo or Return Order keep their setting.
#13672 is listed among 'smaller fixes' but is a feature (VAT setup exposed in the Expense Agent Setup Wizard).
'Several behaviour changes followed' implies they were caused by the breaking change; changed to neutral wording.
#13554 and #13824 were vaguely described as extending the Fabric API setup; made specific (config package import and table operations, lowercase namespace normalization).
